text:
inc-bot: PAGER — P1: Sustained qps spike from org oakmont (org_id=8421). Alert: 5xx ratio > 4% and tail latency > 2s across us-west-1 serving cluster. Paging oncall.

maria_sre: I'm on it — seeing steady ~4.8x baseline traffic from oakmont. Errors are mostly model-render timeouts + some 503s from queued workers.

leah_cs: FYI oakmont has a live demo event 16:00 PDT, they're likely driving traffic. Reached out to their SE for confirmation.

maria_sre: Initial quick assessment: autoscaler isn't adding capacity fast enough (scale delay) + prefix cache miss rate jumped for their workloads. Taking immediate mitigations: 1) soft rate limit per-org, 2) temporary quota bump request for paid rate class, 3) disable reranker route for that org if needed.

yang_serving: +1 to disabling reranker — it's heavy. Can flip route-level feature gate: 
```
rictl routes feature-toggle --org=8421 --route=/v1/rerank --enable=false
```

tim_account: If we disable rerank we should notify oakmont SE first. Leah, do they accept degraded results for the demo?

leah_cs: I pinged them, SE confirmed they can accept degraded results for 10m window as long as latency improves.

maria_sre: Applying soft rate limit to preserve cluster for other customers. Command: 
```
rictl orgs rate-update --org=8421 --limit-qps=800 --burst=1200 --reason="emergency mitigation 1715004321"
```

maria_sre: Command output: "SUCCESS: org 8421 rate updated. Effective immediately on edge-gateways."

evan_devex: Noted — adding a quick banner to console for affected org: "Temporary request shaping active for oakmont — expect reduced throughput for heavy ops"

maria_sre: Monitoring: their qps dropped to ~60% of peak, 5xx ratio down to 0.9%, p95 latency from 2200ms -> 420ms within 60s. Good signal.

yang_serving: Preparing a fallback: route rewrite to lighter model for any /generate calls over threshold. Prototype command: 
```
rictl routes rewrite --org=8421 --match="/v1/generate" --to_model="redwood-lite-1.1" --threshold=600
```

leah_cs: Oakmont SE confirms they want reranker off and will accept light model for long prompts. They asked for ETA on restoring full service.

maria_sre: Action plan: keep soft RL for 15m, reranker disabled now, fallback model in canary (10%) for 5m then scale if healthy. If metrics stable, lift RL and re-enable reranker after coordination.

tim_account: Please tag me before re-enable so I can notify customer.

maria_sre: Will do. Handing off to yang_serving for follow-up monitoring and rollback ops. I'm moving to incident-checklist state -> active-mitigation for postmortem capture.

yang_serving: Taking over monitoring. I have dashboards up: oakmont_qps, org_5xx_pct, p95_latency, prefix_cache_miss. Will post updates.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied by maria_sre — org-level rate shaping + reranker feature disabled. Status: mitigated -> watch.

maria_sre: Quick note for postmortem: consider adding an org burst policy for demo windows and faster warmup for prefix cache.

yang_serving: Canary moved from 10% -> 30% after 3m with no regression. p95 stable ~480ms. Continuing watch; will roll back controls if we stay green for 10m.

leah_cs: Customer says demo continues and they see improvements. They asked if we can keep the lighter model for remainder of event.

maria_sre: Approved for the event. I will keep RL in place and reranker disabled until EOD PDT unless we need to re-enable earlier. Tagging incident for follow-up.

evan_devex: Logging commands used and short runbook entry to /runbooks/incidents/oakmont-qos-2024-04.md (internal)

maria_sre: Closing active paging for now — oncall remains monitoring for another 20m. If anything flares, re-open.

yang_serving: last check: qps sits at baseline, 5xx < 1%, p95 430-520ms. All good.

inc-bot: PAGING CLOSED by maria_sre at 1715004620 — incident moved to post-incident review queue."
